chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a curious opening: bell sparkles climb upward like fireflies, then the lead calls the rising three-note lift from the hometown tune and holds it, a question in the air, leading into the theme}
positive_styles: C Lydian, bright major with a raised fourth for wonder
soft pulse-wave lead with a rising questioning melody
bright bell and celesta sparkle figures climbing upward like lantern windows
dreamy wandering orchard at blue hour, curious and wondering, a little mysterious

chunks.text:
[Main Theme]
{the orchard melody: a hummable rising phrase with the bright raised fourth, answered by a bell echo each time, harp rolling underneath at a gentle walk}
positive_styles: C Lydian, bright major with a raised fourth for wonder

bright bell and celesta sparkle figures climbing upward like lantern windows
dreamy wandering orchard at blue hour, curious and wondering, a little mysterious

chunks.text:
[Main Theme Reprise]
{the same melody again with a celesta counter-line glinting between phrases and a soft shaker walk, a little fuller}
positive_styles: C Lydian, bright major with a raised fourth for wonder

chunks.text:
[Bridge]
{contrast: a hushed turn to A minor, the lead lower and slower, a faint mysterious shimmer like something fallen glowing among the trees, then the bells climb back toward the light}

chunks.text:
